title: Ostriv
summary: Ostriv, meaning 'island' in [[ukrainian|Ukrainian]], refers to various locations within Ukraine and a video game. The term encompasses multiple places across several Ukrainian oblasts.

sections.heading: Arts and Entertainment
paragraphs: Ostriv is also the title of a video game, contributing to the cultural landscape of [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Geographical Locations in Ukraine
paragraphs: Ostriv is a name associated with several locations throughout Ukraine, including:
In [[chernihiv-oblast|Chernihiv Oblast]], there is Ostriv located in [[nizhyn|Nizhyn]] Raion.
In [[ivano-frankivsk-oblast|Ivano-Frankivsk Oblast]], Ostriv can be found in [[ivano-frankivsk-raion|Ivano-Frankivsk Raion]].
[[khmelnytskyi-oblast|Khmelnytskyi Oblast]] features Chornyi Ostriv in [[khmelnytskyi|Khmelnytskyi]] Raion.
In [[kyiv-oblast|Kyiv Oblast]], Ostriv is located in [[bila-tserkva-raion|Bila Tserkva Raion]].

[[lviv-oblast|Lviv Oblast]] has multiple instances of Ostriv, including Ostriv in [[sheptytskyi|Chervonohrad]] Raion, Sambir Raion, Stryi Raion, [[zolochiv|Zolochiv]] Raion, and Chornyi Ostriv in [[zhydachiv|Zhydachiv]] Raion.
In [[rivne-oblast|Rivne Oblast]], Ostriv is present in Volodymyrets Raion, Dubno Raion, and Radyvyliv Raion.
In [[volyn-oblast|Volyn Oblast]], Ostriv is located in Kivertsivskyi Raion.
Lastly, in [[zhytomyr-oblast|Zhytomyr Oblast]], Ostriv can be found in Ovruch Raion.
